messages.content: You are a verification specialist answering multi-hop questions using the supplied Wikipedia evidence. Treat peer claims as unverified; verify them against quoted evidence. {"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Splendid China Mall (Traditional Chinese: 錦繡中華; Simplified Chinese: 锦绣中华) (formerly known as Splendid China Tower) is a 90000 sqft Chinese-themed ethnic shopping centre located at the southeast corner of Redlea Avenue and Steeles Avenue in the Scarborough district of Toronto, Ontario, Canada.","title":"Splendid China Mall"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It is located adjacent to Milliken GO Station and across from the Pacific Mall along with the Market Village.","title":"Splendid China Mall"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The structure was formerly occupied by Canadian Tire.","title":"Splendid China Mall"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Remington Centre (滙通廣場) is an 800,000 sqft Chinese-themed mall to be built at the corner of Kennedy Road and Steeles Avenue in Markham, Ontario, Canada, on the site of the present Market Village mall.","title":"Remington Centre"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It will be connected to Pacific Mall by an indoor walkway.","title":"Remington Centre"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Market Village is scheduled for demolition and construction of the new mall was to have begun in the third quarter of 2013, but as of early 2017, Market Village remains in operation with no signs of closure, but some long term tenants have left including McDonald's in late 2015.","title":"Remington Centre"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" As of March 2017, certain stores have started selling off all inventory with sales staff mentioning the reason as store closing due to demolition work slated to begin September 2017.","title":"Remington Centre"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":"Steeles Avenue","question":"Which road borders both Pacific Mall and Splendid China Mall ?"}
